_comment: Row 810. The 939 gate's declared census is DERIVED from the tests' own BD_GATE_SCOPE markers (plus the closed _NON_DERIVABLE_DECLARED remainder) instead of a hand-pinned literal. The property the gate's own comment defends -- a marked file dropped from its shard FAILS -- must survive the derivation, so these mutants sever the derivation and the brief's test (1) is the catcher. Re-run from a detached scratch clone: toolchain/bin/bd-mutate --spec tests/mutants/row810_derived_declaration.json --work SCRATCH --timeout 300. The separate transform-control spec applies M1 to an import-only node and must ESCAPE.
subject: the derived declared-gate census still names a marked file that no shard runs

mutants.label: M1 the marker derivation is emptied (returns set())
M2 the census forgets its derived half and keeps only the legacy remainder
M3 the derivation reads every marker as repo-wide (an unmarked file is no longer undeclared)
